C01.summary: The student reports that a classmate has been following them from the IT building to the LRT and continues to message them at [phone] despite being asked to stop. They are scared to attend their 7 PM class and want the behavior stopped.

C02.summary: The student reports that a man has been following them from the TUP gate to the jeepney stop for several days, causing them to feel scared about going home at night. They are requesting assistance to address the stalking and ensure their safety.

C03.summary: The student reports that a blockmate messaged them saying they will wait after the 3 PM class to hurt them. They are afraid to attend class the next day and are seeking protection.

C04.summary: The student failed two subjects and has not told their parents. They are experiencing thoughts that everyone would be better off without them and do not want to wake up tomorrow, expressing a desire to talk to someone. They are asking for immediate help and someone to talk to.

C05.summary: The student reports that while walking home around 6 PM, a man wearing a TUP uniform grabbed them, and they saw the same individual again on campus later. They are requesting assistance regarding this incident.

C06.summary: The student reports that their ex-boyfriend from another section continues to call and message them daily from new accounts despite being blocked and asked to stop. Yesterday, he waited outside the student's classroom. The student is requesting that the behavior cease and that appropriate action be taken.

C07.summary: The student reports that during a one-on-one consultation in the professor's faculty room, the professor placed his hand on the student's thigh and asked them to return alone after class for a grade. The student left immediately and is seeking appropriate action to address the incident and ensure safety for the upcoming class.

C08.summary: The student reported that two other students got into a fight in the canteen, during which one punched the student's friend, causing a nose bleed. The aggressors are still on campus and continue to threaten others. The student is asking for immediate action to address the violence and ensure safety.

C09.summary: The student reported that exposed live wires are hanging from the ceiling fan in Room 305 of the Engineering building, and a classmate received a small electric shock this morning while the class continued. They are requesting that the hazard be addressed immediately to ensure safety.

C10.summary: The student reports that [name] publicly threatened to beat them up if they report him again and showed a knife in his bag. They are seeking protection and appropriate action regarding the threat.

H01.summary: The student reports that blockmates have been posting edited photos of them in the block group chat and laughing about it for the past two weeks, causing embarrassment. They are asking for the behavior to stop and for appropriate action to be taken.

H02.summary: The student, who has a hearing impairment, reports that a professor refused to allow them to sit in the front of the class or use captions and publicly stated that people like them should not be in engineering. They are requesting that the professor honor their accommodation and stop the discriminatory remarks.

H03.summary: The student was given an INC because their professor said the final exam paper was lost. They need the complete grades by Friday to avoid termination of their CHED scholarship.

H04.summary: The student reports that their enrollment is on hold because the system shows an unpaid balance from last year, even though they have already paid and possess the official receipt. Enrollment closes tomorrow, and they will be dropped if the issue is not resolved. They are requesting that the hold be removed and the payment be properly reflected in the system.

H05.summary: The student received a notice that their Tulong Dunong grant was terminated due to alleged GWA issues, but their actual GWA is 1.75, which meets the requirement. They are requesting that the termination be corrected before the payout list is finalized this week.

H06.summary: The student reports that classmates call them hurtful names and mock them daily because they are gay, doing so in front of the whole class. The student says the professor does not intervene. They are asking for action to stop the harassment and ensure they are treated with respect.

H07.summary: The student reports that a peer from another college follows them on Instagram and repeatedly posts rude, sexual jokes on every photo they upload. The student has deleted the comments, but the peer continues to make similar remarks using other accounts. They are requesting the university to address this harassment.

H08.summary: The student’s graduation clearance shows a library hold despite having returned all books and receiving confirmation from the library that there are no outstanding items. They are requesting the hold be removed promptly so they can submit their clearance by the Monday deadline.

H09.summary: The student reports that a meme featuring their face was created and posted on the TUP Freedom Wall page, resulting in many comments and ridicule. They feel embarrassed and are hesitant to attend their organization because of this. The student is seeking assistance to address the harassment.

H10.summary: The student passed all requirements to join a college organization, but the officers refused membership because the student is Muslim and cannot attend events during Friday prayers. They are requesting that the denial be addressed and that they be allowed to join.

M01.summary: The student reports that their adviser changed the Chapter 3 thesis deadline to Friday, but two team members are ill. They are asking OSA to request a one‑week extension on their behalf.

M02.summary: The student accidentally paid their miscellaneous fee twice via GCash and has both reference numbers. They are requesting a refund for the second payment.

M03.summary: The student reports that their Certificate of Registration (COR) incorrectly lists their program as BSIE instead of BSIT. They need a corrected COR issued promptly for ID validation next week.

M04.summary: The aircon in Room 402 of the Main Building has been broken for a week, causing the room to become very hot during afternoon classes. The student is requesting that the aircon be repaired promptly because some students are feeling dizzy.

M05.summary: The student’s portal account was locked after resetting their password, preventing them from viewing grades and checking the upcoming exam schedule. They are requesting that the account be unlocked so they can access this information.

M06.summary: The student reports that two of their subjects are scheduled at the same time on Tuesdays from 1:00 to 4:00 PM. They are asking for the conflict to be resolved before the second week of classes begins.

M07.summary: The student lost their school ID, and security guards are refusing entry to campus. They are requesting a fast replacement before midterms begin next Monday.

M08.summary: The student was charged a 500‑peso fine by the library for a book they claim they returned on time. They are asking that the fine be waived or removed before the end of the month.

M09.summary: The student reports that a subject's grade has not been posted on the portal even though the semester has ended. They need the grade to complete their scholarship renewal next month.

M10.summary: The student needs a certificate of good moral character for an internship application that is due next week. They are asking how to request the certificate and how long the process will take.

L01.summary: The student lost their school ID last week and is asking for the steps to obtain a replacement and the associated fee. They request information on the process and cost for a new ID.

L02.summary: The student notes that many students wait near the gym between classes and there are not enough benches or shade in that area. They are requesting additional benches and shading to improve comfort.

L03.summary: The student reports that the prices of meals in the canteen have increased compared to the previous semester and are now considered expensive. They are requesting that more affordable food options be made available for students.

L04.summary: The student’s group wants to create a new photography club and is asking about the requirements for official recognition by the OSA. They are requesting information on the steps and documentation needed to be recognized as a student organization.

L05.summary: The student is asking when the scholarship applications will open for the current year. They request information on the opening date of the scholarship application process.

L06.summary: The student thanks a staff member from OSA for patiently helping them with their clearance last week. They are expressing gratitude for the great service.

L07.summary: The student requests that the library extend its operating hours until 8 PM during exam weeks because many students lack a quiet place to study at home. They are asking for a change in the library schedule to accommodate this need.

L08.summary: The student asks whether wearing shorts is allowed on campus during PE day, noting they could not find the information in the handbook. They are seeking clarification on the dress code for that specific day.

L09.summary: The student asks what color of ID lace first-year students should use this semester, noting they observed different colors at the gate. They are seeking clarification on the correct lace color.

L10.summary: The student finds the new STARS portal easy to use and is satisfied with it. They suggest adding a search bar on the concerns page to locate older concerns more quickly.
